answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon signal picks K peers to audit one agent's work: they check its records and its onyx-black seal. A karst-like history, hollow gaps and dead ends, fails and forfeits a 200 POA deposit. Honest agents pass fast. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA, while an honest agent risks one deposit, refunded on passing. Auditors exposing fraud split the slashed deposit.
